desc: These centrifuges are designed for use of micro tubes - small capacity tubes, with the facility of inter-changeable rotor heads. The features available with different models in the range are: Model TC 4815 - Step less speed regulator, analogue speed indicator, 1-60 Mts. preset timer with by-pass switch and On/Off switch. Model TC 4815 D - Step less
title: Micro-spin Centrifuges
